context.sceneMix: Level 4 boss gameplay in Default mode; observed existing battlefield plus 12 temporary diagnostic units (3 each Bulwark, Gravitas Breaker, Arachnid Hexapod, Command Relay), native AI units and AI buildings; camera 1920x1080.
context.capacityIneligibilityReason: Low- and high-load captures were taken at the same scene/camera but entity composition changed independently: 15 entities (1 player, 5 AI units, 9 AI buildings) at low load versus 35 (13 player including 12 diagnostic units, 12 AI units, 10 AI buildings) at high load. The triangle delta is therefore evidence only, not a controlled geometry-only capacity pair.
context.limitation: Frame intervals are realized Unity pacing. Frustum triangles exclude occlusion, particles, terrain-specific paths, shadows and GPU-instanced draws; no CPU/GPU timing is collected.
